judgements: P01 multiple-choice set exercises objectives 01, 02, 03 and 05; P02 structured question exercises 01 and 03. Objective 04 (indices) is practised by its four cards and the notes only.
Simpson's index is taught in the form D = 1 - sum of (n/N) squared, with a note that the syllabus annexe typesets the square outside the bracket, per the plan decision.
The Lincoln index is not an objective of 5.3; it is named only in the cross-link to 1.2, where it is taught with its formula.
